question: Corrosion is a type of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**oxidation reaction.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Corrosion** is a type of **oxidation reaction.**
 
• Corrosion is a process of** gradual destruction or deterioration** of metals due to chemical reactions with their environment.
 
• This process involves the** loss of electrons** from metal atoms, which is known as** oxidation.**
 
• During corrosion, metal atoms lose electrons and form **positive ions**, which combine with **negative ions** from the environment to form **corrosion products** such as **rust, tarnish, or patina.**
 
• Corrosion can occur in various forms such as** uniform corrosion, pitting corrosion, galvanic corrosion, and crevice corrosion.**
 
• Each type of corrosion has its own specific mechanism and can be influenced by factors such as **temperature, humidity, pH, and presence of corrosive agents.**
 
• Corrosion can be prevented or minimized by various methods such as **surface coatings, cathodic protection, alloying, and proper design** and maintenance of structures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Displacement reaction** is a type of chemical reaction in which** one element or ion displaces** another element or ion from a compound.

 
 
• For example, when zinc metal is added to hydrochloric acid, **hydrogen gas** is evolved and** zinc chloride** is formed.
 
 
 
• **Decomposition reaction **is a type of chemical reaction in which a compound breaks down into** simpler compounds** or elements.
 
 
• For example, when calcium carbonate is heated, it decomposes into **calcium oxide** and **carbon dioxide.**
 
 
 
• **Double displacement reaction** is a type of chemical reaction in which two compounds **exchange ions** to form two new compounds.
 
 
• For example, when sodium chloride is mixed with silver nitrate, **silver chloride and sodium nitrate** are formed.
